errors.global404Title: 404 — you took a wrong turn at the CDN
errors.global404Description: This path is not on our storefront map—maybe a stale bookmark, maybe a typo. The homepage still likes you.
errors.cmsPageNotFoundDescription: No active CMS page matches that address—it may be unpublished, renamed, or still a draft hiding in the admin.
errors.productNotFoundDescription: We could not find a live product for this URL. It may have left the catalog or the link needs a refresh.
